title: SEC2: no efficiency issues in aubi refactor
description: Reviewed all three changes in stoa-526bc4c6 for efficiency impact. (1) Adding crates/auth to workspace members: stoa-auth was already a direct dep of 5 crates; cargo build already compiled it; workspace-member status adds zero incremental compile cost. (2) pub use stoa_auth::UserCredential re-export: a pub use alias resolves to the same concrete type; before the change there were two separate Deserialize impls for structurally identical types; after the change there is one, making this a net binary size reduction with no extra monomorphization. (3) Deleting reader credentials.rs and updating 5 import sites: import-only changes; no runtime or compile-time cost beyond path resolution. No efficiency concerns. No action required.
